title: Player Login Ding
description: Plays a distinct noteblock note at the time when a player joins/leaves the game [both situations having their own sounds]
body:
# Player Login Ding

Never miss a player joining or leaving again.

Player Login Ding plays a distinct note block sound whenever a player connects or disconnects from your server — a bright pling when someone joins, and a deep bass when someone leaves. No configuration needed, no bloat, just install and go.

## **Features**
- Distinct sounds for join and leave events so you can tell them apart instantly
- Plays to all online players regardless of where they are on the map
- Server-side only — connecting players don't need to install anything
- Works in singleplayer too via the integrated server

## **Requirements**
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric API
